Maya Chen: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's spike. I decomposed the latency trend and saw consistent tail growth between 02:10-02:40 UTC driven by KV-cache write stalls + large batching from ingestion pipeline. Thinking we need both an SLO recalibration and a short remediation play: reduce max batch size + bump 95th SLO to 150ms while we fix IO contention. Thoughts?

Ethan Rodriguez: Can you paste the decomposition graphs?

Maya Chen: Pasted key snippets to the dashboard — see link https://redwood/dashboards/latency/decomp (perm view) — main signal is CPU queueing on cache-hosts, not model exec.

Priya Nair: Agree this looks like infra-side contention. Do we have an error-budget burn calc if we move 95->150ms for 2 weeks?

Maya Chen: Quick math: 95th currently 120ms, error budget 99.9% availability target. If we relax to 150ms for 2 weeks, projected burn ~0.4% of monthly budget (assuming normal traffic). Low risk and avoids throttling user requests while infra fix rolls out.

Samir Patel: @Maya can you create action items with owners & ETA? I'll pick up the batching config change in the ingestion service, ETA 48h.

Maya Chen: Action items draft: 1) Short-term: lower ingestion max_batch from 2048->1024 and add jitter (owner Samir, 48h) 2) Mid-term: investigate KV-cache write amplification & patch driver (owner Ethan, 1 week) 3) Observability: add prefix-level trace for cache write-latency, dashboard tile, and alert (owner Priya, 72h) 4) SLO policy: temporary 95th -> 150ms for 14 days (owner Jules, ops, immediate) 5) Runbook: add step to fall back to read-through cache on high write-latency (owner Maya, 5 days).

Jules (ops): I'll schedule the SLO tweak and add a note to the SLA change log. Will set the policy to auto-revert after 14 days.

Priya Nair: For the alert + dashboard, proposing query: 
```
sum(rate(cache_write_latency_bucket{le="0.150"}[5m])) / sum(rate(cache_write_latency_count[5m]))
```
Set warn at 0.95 and fire at 0.99 for 5m. Also add a grafana heatmap for write size distribution.

Samir Patel: I'll open PR for batching change and add canary rollout steps. Will note perf test results in PR.

Ethan Rodriguez: On KV driver — I can repro write stalls locally with synthetic heavy batches. Suspect fsync behavior + small file writes. Will instrument and propose patch by end of week.

Maya Chen: Good. Two more things: recurring incident pattern check — I searched last 90 days, found 3 similar mini-spikes aligned with ingestion bursts. We should add a post-incident recurring-pattern ticket to track frequency and trigger an automated mitigation if >2 events in 30d. Owner: Maya, ETA 7d.

Jules (ops): Noted. I'll update the SLO dashboard owners and create the temporary SLO ticket. Also will adjust PagerDuty policy so this class of incidents pages only on sustained 5m > 0.99 threshold (reduce noise).

incident-bot: Created ticket INF-4521 "latency: KV-write stalls & ingestion batching" and linked this thread.

Priya Nair: One optional ask: can we add a synthetic probe targeting the cache-write path at 1m cadence? That would help detect early regression.

Samir Patel: Yep, I'll add a canary job as part of the batching PR.

Maya Chen: Recap/owners: Samir (batching PR, 48h), Priya (alert/dashboard + probe, 72h), Ethan (driver investigation/patch, 7d), Jules (SLO change + PD tweak, immediate), Maya (runbook + recurrence ticket, 7d). Will run a 15m sync tomorrow to confirm PR/linkage. Thanks :thumbsup:

Ethan Rodriguez: :eyes: Sounds good.

Jules (ops): Thanks everyone. I'll post the SLO adjustment notice in #announcements after PD and ticket are updated.

Maya Chen: Leaving this thread open for updates, will close after all items have PRs/tickets linked.
